name: Stellar Storm Capacitor Cannon
title: STELLAR STORM
CAPACITOR CANNON
description: Lasts 3 of your turns. Each shot requires a newly played Ionoflash Reserve card and spends 1 charge. Deals {base} nominal HP plus {bonus} HP per living allied support, without sacrificing ally HP. Skipping an energy payment skips that turn's shot; it may fire again in remaining turns. Normal defenses and cover apply.
